The closed piston takes in 900 J of heat and performs 250 J of work, with its bulk kinetic and potential energy unchanged.
For the closed piston receiving 900 J and doing 250 J of work, the internal energy rises by 650 J.
For the piston heated by 900 J while doing 250 J of work, internal energy is a state quantity and heat depends on the process.

For the three genres with 18, 30, and 42 books, each shelf contains a single genre and all shelves must be filled equally.
The largest common divisor of the genre totals 18, 30, and 42 is 6, which sets the maximum number of books per shelf.
For 18, 30, and 42 books in the respective genres, the shelf counts are 3, 5, and 7 after division by 6.

An ideal 10 V source starts charging the initially uncharged 1000-ohm and 4-mF series circuit.
For the initially uncharged 1000-ohm and 4-mF series circuit, the resistance times capacitance gives a time constant of 4 seconds.
After one time constant in the initially uncharged 1000-ohm and 4-mF series circuit, the capacitor voltage is approximately 6.32 V.

For a uniform wait from 3 through 23 minutes, the expected waiting time is 13 minutes.
For a uniform wait from 3 through 23 minutes, the probability of waiting between 7 and 15 minutes is 2/5.
For a uniform wait from 3 through 23 minutes, the probability of a wait lasting exactly 7 minutes is zero.
